4.intro: A healthcare platform with an established search presence, but room to turn its existing exposure into more organic clicks. The project combined search-result presentation, structured data and mobile experience improvements.
4.challenge: Bedaya Health started with 53.6K clicks, 2.76M impressions and a 1.9% CTR over three months. I focused on how its medical pages appeared in search and how they loaded on mobile.
steps: Improve the search-result message
I rewrote titles and meta descriptions to show what each medical page covered.
Add relevant structured data
I added MedicalWebPage and FAQ structured data to describe the content on relevant pages.
Address the mobile experience
I worked on Largest Contentful Paint and Cumulative Layout Shift to improve loading and layout stability on mobile.
4.insight: Over the later three-month period, clicks reached 109K (+103%) and impressions reached 5.06M. CTR rose from 1.9% to 2.1%, and average position improved from 8.5 to 8.1.
4.lesson: The project combined changes to search snippets, structured data and the mobile experience across key medical pages.

2.intro: A technical recovery project for a software and automation website with very limited organic search activity. The focus was on removing discovery barriers and making commercial pages more relevant to the people searching for its solutions.
2.challenge: Botsmsg started with 31 clicks and 2.53K impressions over three months, with an average position of 24. I focused on indexing barriers and the pages describing its automation services.
steps: Audit crawl and discovery issues
I audited crawl errors and indexing barriers affecting important pages.
Refine the XML sitemap
I refined the XML sitemap to help search engines discover important URLs.
Align commercial landing pages with intent
I updated commercial landing pages around searches for automation and chatbot solutions.
2.insight: In the later three-month period, clicks rose from 31 to 652 and impressions reached 43.8K. Average position improved from 24 to 6.8.
2.lesson: I paired crawl and sitemap work with updates to the pages people use to explore Botsmsg’s services.

3.intro: A medical specialist’s website needed to establish visibility in a landscape occupied by larger healthcare providers. The project organized content around patient questions and connected related topics through internal links.
3.challenge: The site started with 464 clicks and 30.8K impressions over three months. I focused on the symptoms and procedures prospective patients search for within the doctor’s specialty.
steps: Organize a specialty-focused topic map
I grouped related topics around the doctor’s specialty to give the pages a clear structure.
Connect related content internally
I linked related pages so readers could move between relevant topics.
Address more specific patient searches
I targeted specific symptom and procedure queries in the content.
3.insight: Clicks reached 1.57K and impressions reached 160K over the later three-month period. Impressions grew faster than clicks, and CTR moved from 1.5% to 1.0%.
3.lesson: The work gave patient questions a clear place in the site structure and connected them through internal links.

1.intro: A new nutrition and supplements website needed to develop its organic search presence in a trust-sensitive category. The work combined evidence-supported content with an internal-linking structure connecting related content and products.
1.challenge: Right Nutritions started with zero recorded clicks and impressions. I worked on building search visibility for a new nutrition and supplements site through content and internal links.
steps: Focus on evidence-supported content
I focused on nutrition content that used scientific evidence to support health-related information.
Build a hub-and-spoke structure
I organized related pages around topic hubs and linked each hub to its supporting pages.
Connect relevant content and product pages
I linked relevant informational pages to related products.
1.insight: Search Console recorded 434 clicks and 23.3K impressions in the later three-month period, with a CTR of 1.9% and an average position of 7.6.
1.lesson: The project established a search baseline and gave visitors paths between nutrition topics and related products.

0.intro: A local used-furniture website competing for searches with buying and selling intent. The work connected category-page relevance with mobile usability and server-response improvements.
0.challenge: The site started with 79 clicks and 4.58K impressions over three months, with an average position of 39.7. I focused on category pages for people looking to buy or sell used furniture locally.
steps: Prioritize transactional category searches
I optimized category pages around local buying and selling searches.
Improve server response
I worked on server response times as part of the technical improvements.
Refine the mobile user experience
I simplified the mobile interface to make browsing easier.
0.insight: Clicks reached 271 (+243%) and impressions reached 24.6K over the later three-month period. Average position improved by 12 positions, while CTR fell by 0.6 percentage points.
0.lesson: The work brought the category pages closer to local buying and selling searches and made them easier to browse on mobile.
